how: Evanston Art Center lists adult Intro to Figurative Sculpture, Ceramic Sculpture and Evening Figure Sculpture courses.
Chicago Park District lists 34 designated off-leash Dog Friendly Areas in parks and beaches such as Montrose Beach and Puptown.
Chicago Park District lists about 98 community gardens where residents rent allotment plots, share space or volunteer.
The Second City Training Center offers acting, improv and comedy classes plus drop-in sessions; Piven Theatre in Evanston also runs adult acting classes.
The Illinois Mycological Association holds monthly talks and mycologist-led forays (surveys) to find and identify wild fungi, with dates posted.
Chicago Magic Lounge stages close-up and stage magic and runs the six-week Chicago Magic College Level One course for beginners (21+).
NAMI Chicago runs free, confidential peer-led support groups for adults with mental health conditions and for family members and caregivers.
PAWS Chicago operates the Pippen Fasseas Adoption Center in Lincoln Park with online pet listings and adoption events, plus volunteer programs.
The Peggy Notebaert Nature Museum's Judy Istock Butterfly Haven is a 2,700 sq ft greenhouse with over 1,000 free-flying butterflies, plus an outdoor Woody Wickham Butterfly Garden.
Montrose Point Bird Sanctuary on the lakefront is a major migration birding site with wintering roosting owls reported, but no dedicated raptor-watch programme was found.
Chicago Hearing Society offers adult, youth and family American Sign Language classes (the local sign language rather than Singapore Sign Language).
The Zen Buddhist Temple of Chicago holds Sunday public meditation services and a four-session introductory meditation course open to non-Buddhists.
Lion dances feature in Chinatown festivals such as the Double Ten Parade; no regular lion dance troupe class was confirmed.
The Chicago Park District Community Stewardship Program lets volunteers do litter pickup, trail maintenance, invasive plant removal, seed collection and native planting in natural areas.
venue: Chicago Park District Community Stewardship Program

how: The Chicago Park District permits kiteboarding at Montrose Beach on Lake Michigan.
The Griffin Museum of Science and Industry displays the captured WWII German submarine U-505 (a National Historic Landmark) with on-board tours and Enigma and patrol exhibits.
venue: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry (U-505)

how: Orienteering USA lists the Chicago Area Orienteering Club (CAOC) as the local club running events in the region.
The Chicago Rocks and Minerals Society for rock, mineral and fossil enthusiasts of all levels meets monthly in Skokie and co-runs the annual Chicagoland Gem, Mineral & Fossil Show.
No local digs; the University of Chicago's Institute for the Study of Ancient Cultures museum (formerly Oriental Institute) shows Near Eastern galleries and offers docent and volunteer roles.
venue: Institute for the Study of Ancient Cultures Museum

how: Meetup lists Chicago-area live poker groups such as Sub Rosa Poker Club and Chicago Poker Players Club hosting $1/$2 and 1/3 no-limit hold'em cash games; no casino poker room was confirmed.
Meetup lists many Chicago interest groups such as Chicago Hiking Outdoors & Social Group and NW Chicago Social Group over 50 that run regular events.
